title: Counting Bits
description: Given an integer `n`, return an array `ans` of length `n + 1` where `ans[i]` is the number of `1` bits in the binary representation of `i`. A solution that runs in O(n) total time is possible.
hints: Counting bits separately for each i is O(n log n). Can an answer you already computed help with the next one?
Shifting i right by one drops its last bit, giving a smaller number you have already counted.
starterCode:
class Solution:
    def countBits(self, n: int) -> List[int]:

expected.$py: [sum((i>>k)&1 for k in range(17)) for i in range(100001)]

solution.explanation: Use dynamic programming over the numbers. The binary form of i is the binary form of i >> 1 plus one more last bit, so ans[i] = ans[i >> 1] + (i & 1), with ans[0] = 0. Each value is derived from a smaller one in constant time, giving O(n) time and O(n) space for the output.
